title: SecurityHealthCheckAlertRecipient - Data API
description: Represents a recipient configuration for Security Health Check alerts. Use this object to manage who receives Security Health Check notifications and how they are delivered.

IsAdminNotifyEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsAdminNotifyEnabled.description: Indicates whether admin notification is enabled for Security Health Check alerts. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the Security Health Check alert recipient configuration.

NotificationType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
NotificationType.description: The type of notification sent. For example, a Chatter feed or push notification.

RecipientEmails.description: The email addresses of the recipients who receive Security Health Check alerts.
